title: GTA 6 Update 01.002.002: Official Patch Notes and What Changed
seoTitle: GTA 6 Update 1.002.002 Patch Notes & Fixes | GTASIX
metaDesc: GTA 6 November 23 update 01.002.002: all 7 Rockstar-confirmed fixes, PS5 and Xbox version numbers, download sizes, and how to update safely.
summary: See the November 23 GTA VI patch, seven official fixes, version checks and what to do if the same problem continues.
answer: Rockstar's November 23, 2026 GTA VI launch update addresses crashes, frozen weather, autosave, missing phone calls needed for missions, stuck Wanted Levels, an unusable gym deadlift bar and missing partner bag handovers at fences. PS5 is reported as version 01.002.002 and Xbox as 1.0.2.2. The patch does not promise to fix every crash or recover overwritten progress.
steps: Read the November 23 patch list on Rockstar Support before assuming an internet rumor is an official change.
Check the installed game version in your console's game-information screen. Published reports identify PS5 as 01.002.002 and Xbox as 1.0.2.2; numbering can differ by platform.
PS5: highlight GTA VI on the home screen, press Options, select Check for Update, then follow Sony's download instructions.
Xbox Series X|S: open My games & apps, then Manage and Updates. Select the GTA VI update if one is pending.
After the update, restart the game normally and retry the exact symptom—mission call, autosave, fence transaction, or Wanted Level—that previously failed.
If the bug persists, note the game version and console model and consult Rockstar Support. The notes identify categories of fixes, not every possible cause.
Do not overwrite or delete local/cloud save data in order to force an update; patch installation and save deletion are separate actions.
faqs: What is the latest GTA 6 patch on November 24, 2026?
The latest Rockstar-documented launch update is dated November 23 and addresses seven categories of gameplay bugs.
How big is GTA 6 update 01.002.002?
Gaming publications report approximately 604 MB on PS5 and 1.6 GB on Xbox; actual downloads may vary.
Does the update fix GTA 6 autosave?
Rockstar lists a fix for a condition where the game did not autosave correctly. It does not promise restoration of already-lost progress.
Did the update add GTA 6 Online or a 60 FPS mode?
Neither feature appears in the published patch notes.
Why is my game still crashing after the patch?
The notes say several crashes were fixed, not all. Update and use the console-specific troubleshooting guide.

title: GTA 6 Autosave Not Working or Progress Lost: Protect Your Saves
seoTitle: GTA 6 Autosave Not Working? Lost Progress Help | GTASIX
metaDesc: GTA 6 autosave stopped working or you lost progress? Check the November 23 fix, manual saves, cloud-sync risks and safe PS5/Xbox recovery steps.
summary: Understand the GTA 6 autosave bug and first patch, protect manual saves and avoid overwriting your remaining progress.
answer: Rockstar's November 23 patch addressed a GTA VI autosave failure. That does not guarantee already-lost progress can be restored. Before retrying, identify the newest manual and autosave entries without replacing them. In free roam, use the pause menu's Game → Save Game and a separate slot before ending a session.
aliases: gta 6 save not working after update
steps: Check your installed GTA VI version and install the available official update; Rockstar's November 23 patch specifically includes an autosave fix.
Open Pause Menu → Game → Load Game to inspect the timestamps of available manual saves and autosave entries. Do not select a slot to overwrite while investigating.
If your current playthrough is accessible, leave active missions and police pursuit, then use Game → Save Game in free roam to create a new manual slot.
Do not rely on quick return to the console home screen. Confirm your manual save's timestamp before quitting normally.
PS5: examine local and cloud saved-data versions without immediately choosing an upload/download direction. Xbox: review cloud sync prompts before accepting a conflicting copy.
If you have already loaded an older save, do not assume the patch can recreate later unsaved events. Record the timeline and contact Rockstar support if saves are missing.
Before a major heist, story branch or long collectible session, keep a separate save so an accidental overwrite does not erase your only rollback point.
faqs: Does GTA 6 autosave automatically?
Yes, but reports show one rolling autosave, not a history of every activity. Manual saves offer additional rollback points.
How many manual save slots does GTA 6 have?
GamesRadar's post-launch guide reports 15 manual slots plus a separate autosave.
Why is Save Game grayed out?
It is not generally available during a mission or active danger; finish or leave that activity and retry in free roam.
Will the November 23 update restore lost progress?
Rockstar confirms a fix to future autosaving behavior but does not state it restores previously overwritten saves.
Should I delete my cloud saves to fix the problem?
No. Inspect timestamps and preserve both copies until you know which contains the latest progress.

title: GTA 6 Phone Call Not Triggering? Fix the Missing Next Mission
seoTitle: GTA 6 Phone Call Not Triggering? Next Mission Fix | GTASIX
metaDesc: GTA 6 next mission not showing or story phone call never arrives? Check the November 23 patch, quest prerequisites and a spoiler-light troubleshooting checklist.
summary: Find out whether a missing GTA 6 story phone call is a mission requirement, a timing issue or the bug addressed in the first update.
answer: Rockstar confirmed it fixed phone calls that failed to trigger, including calls that unlock missions, in the November 23 GTA VI update. First install the patch, check the in-game objective or active marker, try a brief period of free roam, and then retry the relevant story checkpoint. Do not assume every delayed call is a bug.
steps: Record the exact mission you last completed and whether a phone call, map marker or in-game task tells you what is next.
Install the November 23 or newer officially documented GTA VI update; Rockstar's first patch addressed failed story-progression calls.
Check the phone's contacts and messages plus the active mission objective. A missing marker and a missing incoming call are different problems.
If the last mission told you to wait, spend a short period in free roam on an available activity. Some scheduled calls are intended to arrive later.
Try switching between Jason and Lucia only when allowed by the game, and recheck available story markers. Do not assume every character receives the same calls.
If still blocked, save manually outside a mission, restart the game and reload the latest safe slot. Avoid deleting saves.
Use the spoiler-controlled mission helper with the last mission name; if a specific trigger still fails after updating, report the console, version and steps to Rockstar.
faqs: Why do I have no new missions in GTA 6?
Some story steps require a call or prerequisite; the November 23 update also fixed faulty calls that prevented progression.
What patch fixed GTA 6 missing calls?
Rockstar's November 23, 2026 launch update lists phone-call trigger fixes, including story and mission-unlocking calls.
Will switching characters start the next mission?
Only when the next available objective belongs to that character; use the current map and mission instructions instead of treating switching as a universal fix.
How long must I wait for the phone to ring?
There is no single official timer for every mission. Check the specific mission walkthrough and your current objective.
What if there is no mission marker after updating?
Use the mission helper to verify the previous objective, then report a reproducible progression bug if all prerequisites are met.

title: GTA 6 Wanted Level Stuck? How the Police Heat System Works
seoTitle: GTA 6 Wanted Level Stuck? Lose Police Heat | GTASIX
metaDesc: GTA 6 can't lose a Wanted Level? Rockstar's November 23 fix, wanted-star colors, witness recognition and practical escape steps explained.
summary: Understand GTA 6's colored wanted stars and how to tell normal police recognition from the Wanted Level bug patched November 23.
answer: GTA VI uses colored stars and police recognition clues for its Wanted Level system. If stars remain permanently active despite losing pursuit, Rockstar's November 23 update addressed a bug that prevented the Wanted Level clearing. Escaping normal heat means breaking line of sight and reducing the clues linking police to you; six-star situations are exceptional.
aliases: gta 6 wanted level wont go away
steps: Check whether police currently see you (active pursuit) or are searching because they recognize your face, clothes, vehicle or companion.
Break direct line of sight without driving back through an active police search. The game can retain recognition heat after the pursuit itself stops.
Try moving away from busy streets and into cover; when safe, change the vehicle or obvious identifying context if the in-game recognition indicators suggest it matters.
Watch the star colors and recognition icons. GamesRadar describes black-and-white, gray, white and red stars as different search and pursuit states.
Do not assume six stars can be cleared like a low-level pursuit; GamesRadar reports six-star encounters behave differently and are extremely difficult to escape.
If Wanted Level will not resolve after the appropriate gameplay steps, install the November 23 GTA VI patch, which specifically addresses being unable to lose your Wanted Level.
Record your game version, current star color, recognition icons and mission context if the same bug persists after updating.
faqs: What do red wanted stars mean in GTA 6?
GamesRadar describes red stars as police pursuit having been evaded while identifying information remains in the Heat system.
What do gray stars mean?
Reportedly police are searching with information connecting you to the crime, even if they do not have visual contact.
Why can't I lose the GTA 6 Wanted Level?
It may be an active recognition/pursuit state, or a bug Rockstar addressed in the November 23 update.
Can you get six stars in GTA 6?
Yes. GamesRadar's launch coverage describes rare six-star encounters with an unusually intense response.
Did Rockstar patch stuck police heat?
Yes. November 23 official launch notes list a fix for players unable to lose their Wanted Level.

title: GTA 6 Partner Won't Hand Over Bags to a Fence? Fixes
seoTitle: GTA 6 Fence Bag Handover Bug: Nov 23 Fix | GTASIX
metaDesc: GTA 6 partner won't hand over bags at a fence? Rockstar's November 23 patch addresses the bug. Try safe steps without losing stolen goods or progress.
summary: Check the first patch if a partner will not hand over a loot bag for sale to a fence, and protect goods while troubleshooting.
answer: Rockstar's November 23 update addressed a problem where a partner did not hand over bags so they could be sold to fences. Install the latest GTA VI update, confirm you are at the intended fence with the correct goods, and retry a safe transaction; do not discard loot or overwrite your only save.
steps: Confirm whether you are at a fence and the transaction specifically asks your partner to hand over a bag; do not conflate this with an ATM deposit or ordinary car sale.
Check the GTA VI version and install the November 23 update, which explicitly fixes a partner bag handover failure.
Exit the transaction menu without leaving or discarding goods. Re-enter once after the update and a normal game restart.
Check whether the in-game map or task gives you a specific delivery contact, objective or shop; not every type of loot is handled identically.
Before repeating a risky transaction, create a manual save where the game allows it. Do not overwrite your only safe checkpoint.
If the partner still refuses to hand over a bag, note the mission or seller, console, game version, and the exact on-screen prompt for Rockstar Support.
Avoid third-party save editors, account logins or exploit downloads marketed as a 'fence fix'.
faqs: Why won't my GTA 6 partner hand over stolen goods?
Rockstar listed a specific partner handover bug in the November 23 GTA VI patch notes.
Did the latest GTA 6 update fix the fence bug?
The official notes say a failure involving handing over bags for sale to fences was addressed; this does not rule out every related problem.
Is this the same as the GTA 6 money glitch?
No. A failed intended handover at a fence is a game bug; money-loop exploits are a different subject.
Should I throw away the bag and try again?
No. Protect existing progress and test a safe retry after updating before discarding inventory.
Where can I report the problem?
Use Rockstar Games Customer Support with your console, installed version, mission and the precise failed transaction.

title: GTA 6 Safe Codes: Lab Fees, Brian's Lockup and Keypad Tips
seoTitle: GTA 6 Safe Codes: Lab Fees 0420 & Lockup 7700 | GTASIX
metaDesc: GTA 6 safe and keypad codes: 0420 for Moonstone Boutique lab, 7700 for Brian's lockup, and how to find clues when other combinations differ.
summary: The two commonly confused Lab Fees codes, where they belong, why leading zeros matter and how to check other safes safely.
answer: In the Chapter 1 Lab Fees mission, GTA BOOM's hands-on walkthrough gives 0420 for the Moonstone Boutique lab door and 7700 for Brian's lockup. They open different doors. If a code does not work, check that you are at the correct keypad, include any leading zeroes and read the in-game clue for that specific job.
steps: In the Chapter 1 Lab Fees mission, identify which door you need: the lab behind Moonstone Boutique or Brian's separate lockup.
At Moonstone Boutique's lab keypad enter 0-4-2-0, including the leading zero. The clerk gives this number during the mission.
At Brian's lockup use 7-7-0-0, which Brian provides by phone. This is not the boutique lab door.
If the input is rejected, clear the keypad and enter four digits slowly. Check whether your character is at the correct door and the relevant objective is active.
For any other garage or robbery safe, inspect nearby clues and mission notes rather than blindly applying 0420 or 7700.
Some safes use codes tied to the specific job or encounter. Prefer a named, corroborated source and record the lock's location before trusting an online list.
Use a spoiler-conscious walkthrough if stuck; avoid a full all-codes page if you do not want future mission details spoiled.
faqs: What is the GTA 6 Lab Fees lab door code?
0420 is the reported Moonstone Boutique laboratory keypad code in the Lab Fees mission.
What is Brian's lockup code in GTA 6?
7700 opens Brian's lockup in the Lab Fees storyline, as reported by GTA BOOM.
Why does 0420 not work at Brian's lockup?
Because 0420 belongs to the Moonstone Boutique lab door; Brian's lockup uses 7700.
Are all GTA 6 robbery safe codes the same?
No. Some locks have unique codes or mission-specific clues. Find the correct named location first.
Can I skip gathering the code clue?
Do not assume every mission accepts a code before its objective triggers; follow the current mission instructions.

title: GTA 6 Best Aim Assist Settings: Lock-On, Partial or Free Aim?
seoTitle: GTA 6 Best Aim Settings: Lock-On & Sensitivity | GTASIX
metaDesc: GTA 6 best aim settings for PS5 and Xbox: where to find Targeting, Lock-On versus Partial and Free Aim, aim assist strength and reticle options.
summary: Set up easier shooting or manual aim in GTA 6 with clear controller menu paths and three practical, adjustable presets.
answer: On PS5 and Xbox, open Pause Menu → Settings → Gameplay → Combat to find Targeting. Lock-On attempts to snap to the nearest target; Partial helps without locking; Free Aim provides manual control. Begin with Lock-On for simpler combat or Partial for balance, then tune aim sensitivity and assist while testing one repeatable encounter.
steps: Pause GTA VI and open Settings, then Gameplay → Combat to locate Targeting. Labels and the number of available options may change with updates.
Choose Lock-On if you want aiming to select nearby enemies. Choose Partial for assisted control without a hard snap, or Free Aim for a deliberate challenge.
For easier combat, begin with Lock-On and a medium aim-assist value. Leave Shooting Assist and Quick Draw on while learning the controls.
For balanced play, try Partial, moderate Aim Assist Strength, and a comfortable right-stick sensitivity. Test before changing multiple settings at once.
For manual aim, select Free Aim and reduce Aim Assist Strength; turn off Shooting Assist and Drive-By Assist if you want truly minimal assistance.
Open Controller → Aim & Look Sensitivity to adjust horizontal and vertical aim speed in small increments. Check UI → Reticle for hit markers and center-dot visibility.
Test in an ordinary repeatable encounter, not a difficult mission checkpoint. Save or record your previous values so you can revert.
faqs: Where is aim assist in GTA 6?
The Targeting and Aim Assist Strength options are reported under Pause Menu → Settings → Gameplay → Combat.
What is the easiest GTA 6 Targeting mode?
Lock-On offers the greatest assistance by attempting to snap to a nearby target.
Is Partial better than Lock-On?
Partial gives a less automated feeling. Which is better depends on the player's comfort and desired challenge.
What settings make GTA 6 aiming fully manual?
Free Aim with Shooting Assist and Drive-By Assist disabled and assist strength lowered offers the most direct manual control.
How do I change the crosshair?
Look in Settings → UI → Reticle, including hit markers and visibility options.

title: GTA 6 Chapter 1 Missables: What to Do Before Tourist Trap
seoTitle: GTA 6 Chapter 1 Missables & Tourist Trap | GTASIX
metaDesc: GTA 6 Chapter 1 missable side quests: Get Shirley's Rum, Steal the Scooter, Tourist Trap point of no return and how to protect your save.
summary: Before starting Tourist Trap, finish Shirley's two optional quests and keep a Chapter 1 save if you want to preserve the experience.
answer: PowerPyx's walkthrough confirms that Chapter 1 optional jobs Get Shirley's Rum and Steal the Scooter disappear when the mission Tourist Trap begins. Neither is required for GTA VI trophies or 100% completion. If you want to play them, complete both in Key Lento as Jason and create a separate manual save before progressing.
aliases: gta6 tourist trap point of no return
steps: Before accepting Tourist Trap (Take Up Mattia's Offer), consider creating a separate manual save during free roam.
After completing the Chapter 1 prerequisites and unlocking Pipework, find Shirley near Jason's neighborhood in Key Lento and start Get Shirley's Rum.
Follow Shirley's objective to ask the liquor store clerk for her rum, then return it. This unlocks the follow-up quest.
Complete Steal the Scooter for Shirley before moving the chapter forward. PowerPyx identifies it as another Chapter 1-exclusive optional quest.
Check your available time-limited side markers. PowerPyx says an hourglass indicates a mission can expire; do those you care about as they appear.
Start Tourist Trap only once you are comfortable leaving these Chapter 1-exclusive jobs behind.
If you already passed this point, do not panic about Platinum or 100%. According to PowerPyx, these optional missables are not required for those goals.
faqs: What is the Chapter 1 point of no return in GTA 6?
The Tourist Trap mission is reported as the point after which Shirley's Chapter 1 optional jobs cannot be completed.
Is Get Shirley's Rum missable?
Yes. PowerPyx says it becomes unavailable when Tourist Trap starts.
Can you do Steal the Scooter after Chapter 1?
No. The walkthrough describes this optional job as Chapter 1-exclusive.
Will missing Shirley's quests prevent 100% completion?
No. PowerPyx says these two optional quests do not affect trophies or required completion.
Can you replay story missions in GTA 6?
PowerPyx reports no standard mission replay feature, so preserve manual chapter saves if you wish to revisit earlier stages.

title: GTA 6 Fast Travel: Taxi, Bus, Train and RydeMe Explained
seoTitle: GTA 6 Fast Travel: Taxi, Bus, Train & RydeMe | GTASIX
metaDesc: GTA 6 fast travel guide: how to use taxi, bus, train and Chapter 2 RydeMe, skip journeys on PS5/Xbox, and what each option costs.
summary: Learn how GTA 6 transportation works, when taxis and RydeMe become available and how to skip rides on PS5 or Xbox.
answer: GTA VI offers fast-travel options through taxis, public transit and RydeMe rather than an unrestricted teleport-from-anywhere map. GamesRadar reports Paradise Taxi access during Chapter 1 and the RydeMe phone app in Chapter 2. For a taxi ride, request a destination, then use the on-screen skip option once onboard; an additional fee may apply.
aliases: gta 6 how to travel map quickly
steps: Decide whether you need a taxi on demand, a scheduled public bus/train, or the RydeMe rideshare app.
To use Paradise Taxi, unlock its contact during Chapter 1, open the in-game phone with D-pad Up, then call from Contacts.
Choose a destination and get in the taxi. GamesRadar reports you can focus on the driver using L2/LT and select a skip-ride action using Triangle/Y for an extra charge.
For buses or trains, find a real transit stop or station and wait for service, then board and choose a destination along the route.
Once aboard transit, follow the in-game option to skip the remainder of the trip if available.
During Chapter 2, RydeMe is reported to become accessible in the phone. It requests a ride and draws the fare from the in-game online bank balance.
Check the fare and your cash before requesting an expensive journey; fast travel convenience is not free and different services can charge different accounts.
faqs: Can you fast travel in GTA 6?
Yes, through transport options such as taxis, buses, trains and RydeMe, according to GamesRadar's launch guide.
How do you call a taxi in GTA 6?
Unlock the Paradise Taxi contact during Chapter 1, then open the phone and call the service.
When do you unlock RydeMe?
GamesRadar reports RydeMe unlocks during Chapter 2.
Can you skip a taxi ride?
Yes. A reported skip-ride option appears by focusing on the driver, with a separate fee.
Is public transit free?
The reviewed guide describes paid transportation services rather than free teleportation; exact fares and coverage depend on the ride.

title: How Long Is GTA 6? Story Hours, Chapters and 100% Completion
seoTitle: How Long to Beat GTA 6? Story & 100% Time | GTASIX
metaDesc: How long is GTA 6? Compare 60–80 hour story estimates with early tracked-player completion times, five story chapters and 100% completion cautions.
summary: Compare early GTA VI story completion estimates with a tracked sample and understand why exploration and 100% take longer.
answer: GTA VI has five story chapters. PowerPyx's launch walkthrough estimates roughly 60–80 hours for the story with ordinary play. A separate voluntary tracking sample reported a median near 55 hours for 275 finishers on November 24, but that small, self-selected early cohort is not representative of all players. Completionist time varies dramatically with collectibles and side activities.
steps: Decide what you mean by finishing: main story credits, story plus side quests, or full 100% completion. These are not interchangeable.
For a typical story estimate, use PowerPyx's reported 60–80-hour range for the five-chapter campaign, treating it as an editorial estimate rather than a guarantee.
Compare that with self-reported community trackers only if you accept sample bias; early finishers tend to play faster and for longer sessions.
Track your own time by chapter rather than assuming every chapter is equal in length. Some contain more story objectives and more optional diversions.
If you only have a few hours a week, divide your remaining main missions by your personal pace instead of using a universal countdown.
For 100%, plan time for collectibles, activity challenges and exploration beyond the story; the figure will depend on what you skip, look up or do naturally.
Keep manual saves around chapter boundaries if you care about revisiting earlier story events; PowerPyx reports mission replay is not supported.
faqs: How many chapters are in GTA 6?
PowerPyx lists five story chapters in its full walkthrough.
How many hours to finish GTA 6 story?
PowerPyx estimates around 60–80 hours; self-selected tracking samples of early finishers may run faster.
Can you finish GTA 6 in 20 hours?
Some speed-focused players may do so, but it is well below the reported typical story estimate and would omit much exploration.
How long does GTA 6 100% completion take?
There is no single credible universal time. Challenges, collectibles and side missions add substantial variation.
Why do playtime websites give different numbers?
They may count different goals and populations; early samples can overrepresent highly motivated or fast players.
